name: Impostor
description: All players except one will be given a similar word. All players will describe their word as obscure as possible. Every end of the round, all players will vote who they think is the impostor and kick them out of the game.
win_condition: Kick the impostor OR remain undetected as the impostor.
lose_condition: Get kicked as an impostor OR fail to kick the impostor.

name: Find the Killer
description: Players assigned as killers must eliminated all civilians. Civilians will do their normal tasks and can also scream for help. Police must catch all the killers.
win_condition: Eliminate all civilians as a killer OR catch all killers as police.
lose_condition: Fail to eliminate all civilians or get caught as a killer OR fail to catch all killers as police.
